research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Illumio is researching and developing methods for enforcing segmentation policies in co-existence with system firewalls, managing segmentation policies for workloads in secure enclaves, and visualizing segmented networks as hierarchies to aid analysis. Additional work includes using infrastructure policy feedback to refine segmentation, enforcing segmentation with cryptographic proof of identity, and generating vulnerability exposure scores to inform segmentation policy. These areas reflect a focus on breach containment and network security.

overview_description.description: Illumio, the most comprehensive Zero Trust solution for ransomware and breach containment, protects organizations from cyber disasters and enables operational resilience without complexity. By visualizing traffic flows and automatically setting segmentation policies, the Illumio Zero Trust Segmentation Platform reduces unnecessary lateral movement across the multi-cloud and hybrid infrastructure, protecting critical resources and preventing the spread of cyber attacks.
